# Releases

## Version 1.1.0 (2026-09-08)

### New Features

- New output mode: `wayle`.  Allows [Wayle][] to remove the bar button
  when the clock is not running.  Also includes a `sign` attribute in
  the JSON which can be used from CSS to change the button color when
  the timer goes negative.

[wayle]: https://github.com/wayle-rs/wayle
